361: // handleError renders appropriate error responses based on request type
362: func (s *Server) handleError(w http.ResponseWriter, e error) {
363: 	// Preserve CORS headers for API requests
364: 	if CORS() {
365: 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
366: 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
367: 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Authorization, User-Agent, Accept, X-Requested-With")
368: 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
369: 	}
370: 
371: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
372: 	status := http.StatusInternalServerError
373: 	var he *tts.HTTPError
374: 	if errors.As(e, &he) {
375: 		status = he.HTTPStatus()
376: 	}
377: 	w.WriteHeader(status)
378: 	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": e.Error()})
379: }

381: // userAgentTransport is a custom RoundTripper that adds the User-Agent header to all requests
382: type userAgentTransport struct {
383: 	base http.RoundTripper
384: }
385: 
386: func (t *userAgentTransport) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
387: 	// Clone the request to avoid mutating the original
388: 	r := req.Clone(req.Context())
389: 	r.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent())
390: 	return t.base.RoundTrip(r)
391: }

393: // httpClient returns an HTTP client that automatically adds the User-Agent header
394: func (s *Server) httpClient() *http.Client {
395: 	return userAgentHTTPClient(10 * time.Second)
396: }

404: func userAgentHTTPClient(timeout time.Duration) *http.Client {
405: 	return &http.Client{
406: 		Timeout: timeout,
407: 		Transport: &userAgentTransport{
408: 			base: http.DefaultTransport,
409: 		},
410: 	}
411: }

413: // doSelfSigned sends a self-signed request to the ollama.com API
414: func (s *Server) doSelfSigned(ctx context.Context, method, path string) (*http.Response, error) {
415: 	timestamp := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10)
416: 	// Form the string to sign: METHOD,PATH?ts=TIMESTAMP
417: 	signString := fmt.Sprintf("%s,%s?ts=%s", method, path, timestamp)
418: 	signature, err := ollamaAuth.Sign(ctx, []byte(signString))
419: 	if err != nil {
420: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to sign request: %w", err)
421: 	}
422: 
423: 	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s?ts=%s", OllamaDotCom, path, timestamp)
424: 	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, nil)
425: 	if err != nil {
426: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to create request: %w", err)
427: 	}
428: 	req.Header.Set("Authorization", fmt.Sprintf("Bearer %s", signature))
429: 
430: 	return s.httpClient().Do(req)
431: }

433: // UserData fetches user data from ollama.com API for the current ollama key
434: func (s *Server) UserData(ctx context.Context) (*api.UserResponse, error) {
435: 	resp, err := s.doSelfSigned(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/api/me")
436: 	if err != nil {
437: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to call ollama.com/api/me: %w", err)
438: 	}
439: 	defer resp.Body.Close()
440: 
441: 	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
442: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected status code: %d", resp.StatusCode)
443: 	}
444: 
445: 	var user api.UserResponse
446: 	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&user); err != nil {
447: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse user response: %w", err)
448: 	}
449: 
450: 	user.AvatarURL = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", OllamaDotCom, user.AvatarURL)
451: 
452: 	storeUser := store.User{
453: 		Name:  user.Name,
454: 		Email: user.Email,
455: 		Plan:  user.Plan,
456: 	}
457: 	if err := s.Store.SetUser(storeUser); err != nil {
458: 		s.log().Warn("failed to cache user data", "error", err)
459: 	}
